Follow young William Brewster on his Pilgrim Adventure which tells the story of his journey on the Mayflower and the colonisation of the United States of America in 1620. This free app has easy-to-use games and puzzles and augmented reality features that will bring your printed book or on-screen pages to life. 

1. Bring Your Book to Life, lets you scan your ‘A Pilgrim Adventure’ printed book or on-screen pages and see them come to life on your smartphone or tablet.
2. Games and Puzzles, is an easy-to-use collection including word search, picture slider, match the pilgrim image memory cards, and a maze.

Monkie Limited does not collect any personally identifiable information from you or your child. 
This app uses anonymous performance stats for internal purposes to help us to improve the app. You can choose to opt out of this at any time from the in-app Settings menu.
